page.metadataDescription: Compare each cited sentence of a private draft with source text you supply. Every result quotes that text exactly or says no supporting passage was found.
page.heading: Check a draft against the sources it cites.
page.introduction: Paste a passage, its reference list and the source text you hold. Each cited sentence gets a result with the exact passage it rests on.
page.noScript: Enable JavaScript for this local checker. No passage, reference or source text is uploaded.

workspace.label: Private draft check
workspace.privacy: By default your passage, references and source text stay in this tab’s memory and are compared in your browser. Nothing is uploaded or added to public history. Nothing is saved unless you choose Save on this device or download a private file. Your browser and same-origin scripts can access this page and saved drafts.
workspace.refused: This check could not run. Keep the passage, references and source text within 64 KiB in total, with at most 64 references and 128 sentences. Your text remains below.
workspace.stale: Your text changed. Run the check again to update the results.
workspace.done: Check complete. Read each excerpt before relying on a result.
workspace.downloaded: Download started. It contains your passage and excerpts; keep it private.

passage.label: Your passage
passage.guidance: Sentences are checked as written and never reworded. Citations may be written as [3], \cite{key}, [@key], Smith et al. (2020) or (Smith, 2020). A sentence without a citation is listed but not checked.

retention.heading: Optional private retention
retention.notice: Save only when you choose. A device save contains the passage, references and source text in this browser’s local storage. Expired saves cannot be restored and are removed on the next restore attempt; closing the page does not schedule deletion. Browser backups and downloaded files follow your own retention settings. Clearing this tab does not delete a device save.
retention.saved: Private input saved on this device for the selected period.
retention.restored: Private input restored. Results were checked again using the current method.
retention.absent: No current device save is available; expired saves were removed.
retention.cleared: Device save deleted. Text currently in this tab remains until you clear it.
retention.unavailable: Device retention could not be verified. Your current text remains in this tab.

references.label: Reference list
references.guidance: Paste BibTeX, RIS, or one DOI, https link or formatted reference per line. Numbered citations follow the order of this list. References are read as written; no DOI or link is looked up.
references.heading: Source text for each reference
references.sourceGuidance: Paste the text you hold for each cited work. A cited work without text is reported as unavailable, never as unsupported.
references.untitled: No title, DOI or link was read from this entry.

status.described: Described, but no DOI or link

references.complete: This is the complete text of the work
references.unreadable: The reference list could not be read. Use at most 64 references.

results.label: Check results
results.heading: Results
results.summary: Sentences: {claims} · supported: {supported} · partly supported: {partlySupported} · not found: {notFound} · source unavailable: {sourceUnavailable} · not checked: {notChecked}

verdicts.supported: Wording supported by the quoted passage
verdicts.partly-supported: Partly supported by the quoted passage
verdicts.not-found: No supporting passage found in the supplied text

notChecked.script-without-word-spacing: This check compares words separated by spaces and cannot read this sentence’s script.

unavailable.source-text-not-supplied: No text was supplied for this work, so it was not checked.
unavailable.reference-unresolved: This citation could not be bound to a readable reference in the list.
unavailable.reference-ambiguous: This citation matches more than one listed work.
unavailable.reference-year-differs: The list has this author with a different year.
unavailable.different-work: The supplied text identifies a different work. The cited work was not checked.
unavailable.source-identity-unresolved: The recorded source identity cannot be matched to this reference. The cited work was not checked.
unavailable.source-read-incomplete: No supporting passage was found in this partial read. The rest of the cited work is unavailable, so this is not an unsupported verdict.
unavailable.synthetic-source: Synthetic demonstration text cannot support a factual draft verdict.

results.partialCoverage: Only part of this work was supplied; the rest was not searched.
results.suggestionNotice: Suggestions are separate wording matches. They do not change your claims, written citations, verdicts or creator rewards. Read these works before changing your references.
results.noPassage: No supporting passage found in the text you supplied.
results.tentative: The quoted passage is tentative where your sentence is not.
results.closestHeading: Closest passage, not counted as support

difference.reversed-comparison: It reverses the subjects of the comparison.

flags.heading: Reference and citation flags
flags.reference-unresolved: Reference {reference} could not be identified from the list.
flags.reference-not-cited: Reference {reference} is listed but not cited in the passage.
flags.citation-unresolved: {claim}: citation {token} could not be matched to one listed work.
flags.possible-different-work: {claim}: the text names {author}, who is not an author of {reference}. Check that the citation points to the intended work.
flags.source-different-work: {claim}: the supplied source for {reference} identifies a different work ({url}). This citation remains unavailable.
